events.name: Sap's 'Erasure Tour' with Sludge Mother, and El Jumbotron
events.info: Sap is an independent, alternative rock trio from Austin, TX. Infusing the energetic and melodic sonics of 90's grunge with emotionally driven dynamics of contemporary music, Sap creates a perfect soundscape for unpredictable live shows. The band is composed of guitarist/vocalist Evan Fundora, bassist Hank Barna, and drummer Jared Cox. Together they have accrued over 6 million streams worldwide, touring with longstanding bands like The Jins and most recently with up and coming acts such as Clarion, Rehash and Cheerleader Roadkill. Sap is set to go on their own US tour in support of their new 2026 album 'Erasure'. Sludge Mother is a sonic force reigniting the raw energy of 1990's rock anthems. Channeling the heavy, sludgy riffs of Soundgarden and the emotive depth of Alice In Chains, Sludge Mother is resurrecting grunge's soul, reimagined for a new era. Sludge Mother, known for her intense vocals and unfiltered lyricism, fuses the grit of Seattle's golden age with a modern, visceral intensity. The result is a sound that's both familiar and fresh---drenched in fuzzed-out guitars, brooding melodies, and the kind of anthemic choruses that demand to be shouted in dimly lit venues. TikTok Spotify Straight outta the Houston underground! El Jumbotron puts a modern twist on the 90's era indie/punk/grunge sound.

events.info: Mahmoud Chouki New World EnsembleMahmoud , "rdquo" -> Mood" Chouki is a Moroccan master guitarist, multi-instrumentalist, composer, and educator currently living and working in New Orleans. His art draws together music from around the globe.. In addition to training and performing with conservatories around the world, Chouki also teaches music at the Lycée Français de la Nouvelle Orléans and is the music curator for the New Orleans Museum of Art (NOMA). Most recently, he composed the music score for the 2021 Sundance Award winning film, , "rdquo" -> Ma Belle, Ma Beauty." Chouki was also awarded 2020's , "rdquo" -> Best Emerging Artist" by OffBeat Magazine's annual Best of the Beat Awards. His New World Ensemble has been steadily gaining acclaim, earning him Gambit Weekly's 2022 "Best World Music Artist'' Award at their annual Big Easy Awards. Mahmoud Chouki - guitar, cigar box oud Shows at 7:30pm & 9:30pm Doors at 7:00pm & 9:00pm Restuarant is Open 5pm - 10pm for dinner before or after your showtime: Advance Ticket Holders can now automatically make dinner table reservations for the Dining Room online via OpenTable.com ! events.info: "During his four-decade career, Grammy-winning saxophonist Kirk Whalum has played numerous genres of music, infusing it all with his gospel and Memphis-soul roots. As a collaborator, he was worked with such high-profile artists as Whitney Houston, Marcus Miller, Bob James and Quincy Jones," states DOWNBEAT MAGAZINE.
events.pleaseNote: GRAMMY® Award-Winner & 12x-GRAMMY® Award Nominated Jazz Saxophonist, Composer & Bandleader KIRK WHALUM's music is usually described as soulful, passionate & stirring. Prior to his solo career, Kirk became an in demand session player for top artists like Barbara Streisand, Al Jarreau, Luther Vandross, Larry Carlton, Quincy Jones & most notably, Whitney Houston, amongst many others. Kirk toured with Whitney Houston for more than 7 years and it's his sax heard on the mega-hit, "I Will Always Love You", the best-selling single by a female artist in music history! Kirk soon followed that career high point with his phenomenal hit album on Warner Bros. Records, 'For You', perhaps the most successful of over 25 solo recordings to date. Other albums include his eclectic & much lauded, 'Gospel According to Jazz' series, (Chapters 1, 2, 3 and 4), chapter 2 & 4 both received GRAMMY® Award Nominations. "Awesome chops" says ALL ABOUT JAZZ while JAZZ TIMES describes him as "Sensual and Funky."

events.info: Amina Figarova Sextet with Matsiko World Orphan ChoirHailing from Azerbaijan, then New Orleans by way of New York, Amina Figarova is an internationally influenced---and recognized---composer, pianist, and bandleader. Her roles come to the forefront with her sextet band and with a remarkable chemistry that brings her detailed arrangements to life. Every member of the group stands out, but their dedication to Figarova's eclectic and powerful compositions gives the group its depth of feeling. In 2018, Amina composed a suite for a South African children's choir and her sextet, which was performed at the , "rdquo" -> Joy of Jazz" Festival in Johannesburg, South Africa with a student choir from Soweto. Her aspiration was to record this masterpiece with the choir, but due to COVID-19 travel restrictions, it was impossible. However, fate intervened when Amina and Bart found themselves on the same flight from Europe to NYC with the Matsiko World Orphan Choir from Liberia. After conversing with the choir director, they decided to perform and record music together that was originally intended for South Africa. The choir consists of 24 orphaned and at-risk children from Liberia in West Africa. They have performed at jazz festivals and venues with the Amina Figarova Sextet, and churches across the USA in efforts to gain educational sponsors for their siblings, friends and families. events.info: Meet Sorry Ghost - a potent blend of optimism and frustration, loud and soft edges, encouragement and rejection. An indie rock band that thrives in duality, the band, originally hailing from the faraway swamps of Louisiana (now based in Los Angeles), has experienced massive growth in 2026. Heralded for their DIY ethos, virality, and accidental YouTuber status as described by frontman Daniel Anton, the band is helping to usher in the next wave of indie rock by embracing authenticity and showcasing the often comedic inner workings of band life to their large social media following. Theyve earned over 150k consistent monthly listeners across platforms, 430k followers on social media, 130 million views on their content in 2025 alone, multiple placements on Spotifys All New Rock and New Noise editorial playlists, and a dedicated fanbase of thousands of Sogovians (the bands fanbases self-proclaimed descriptor based on the SoGo abbreviation).
